procedure_text: 将2-氯甲苯、催化剂无水三氯化铝和溶剂加入到反应瓶中，在0℃-15℃间滴加甲磺酰氯，滴加完毕，升至室温继续反应，LC跟踪至反应完全，将反应物倒入冰水中，用溶剂萃取，浓缩，得2-氯-6-甲磺酰基甲苯；
procedure_summary: The chlorotoluene starting material is sulfonylated with methanesulfonyl chloride over an anhydrous aluminium trichloride catalyst in a chlorinated solvent, the sulfonyl chloride being added dropwise in the cold and the mixture then warmed to room temperature and followed by LC to completion. The mixture is quenched into ice water, extracted with solvent and concentrated to the aryl methyl sulfone.
notes: Chinese heading: 1)2-氯-6-甲磺酰基甲苯的合成. First step of the process of claim 1, whose preamble reads 三酮类除草剂环磺草酮的合成工艺，包括有以下步骤：. AMBIGUOUS TEMPERATURE, deliberately left unresolved: the Chinese prints 在0℃-15℃间滴加, which reads either as the range 0 ℃ to 15 ℃ or as 0 ℃ down to minus 15 ℃, the minus sign and the range dash being the same glyph. The vision pass judged the whitespace non-evidential, so neither reading is preferred here: conditions.temperature.type is set to range because 间 (between) states that a range was given, and min_c and max_c are left null because the bounds cannot be recovered from the print. The verbatim string is kept in the methanesulfonyl chloride addition_profile. Note that the EN convenience line takes a side, rendering it as between 0℃ and -15℃; the Chinese is authoritative and does not. No listed validation flag covers a numeric ambiguity of this kind, so it is recorded here rather than flagged. Second temperature stage: 升至室温继续反应 warms the mixture to room temperature after the addition, with no time given; only one temperature object exists, so the addition-stage temperature holds it and the room-temperature stage is recorded here and in the addition_profile. Reactor is 反应瓶 (reaction flask) with no volume stated. The solvent is the generic 溶剂 in claim 1; claim 2 names 二氯甲烷、氯仿或 1,2-二氯乙烷 as the alternatives, and all three are listed in compounds[] with role solvent even though only one would be used. The extraction solvent is also the generic 溶剂 and is left null in workup. Being a process claim, no charge, no yield and no reaction time is stated anywhere in this step; per the section-type guidance that absence is not flagged.

Linkage is explicit: the step reads 步骤2)得到的 (obtained in step 2), so linkage_confirmed is true on a textual back-reference as well as on identifier match. procedure_summary: The methyl ester from the preceding step is dissolved in a halogenated solvent with peroxybenzoic acid and bromine is added dropwise at reflux, brominating the ring methyl group at the benzylic position. The mixture is cooled, washed with water and concentrated to the benzylic bromide.
notes: Chinese heading: 5)2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯的合成. Mechanism: a peroxide with bromine at reflux is a radical benzylic bromination, hence mechanism_type radical and peroxybenzoic acid functioning as the initiator; the claim gives it no role word, so its compounds[] role is kept at reagent as in A1 rather than upgraded to initiator. NAMED REACTION CAVEAT: the classical Wohl-Ziegler bromination uses N-bromosuccinimide, while this claim charges elemental bromine (溴素) with a peroxide initiator; the name is recorded for the radical benzylic bromination pattern, and the reagent difference is recorded here rather than silently absorbed. Quantities: 适量的过氧苯甲酸 means an appropriate amount, so no charge exists to record; claim 4 gives only the substrate-to-bromine molar ratio 1:1-1.5 and leaves the peroxide out of that ratio. Time: 1-10h is a range and time_h holds a single float, so time_h is null and the range is recorded here as printed. 回流 is a heating method, not a temperature. 冷却 (cooled) is a workup operation and names no cooling method, so conditions.cooling_method stays null. The solvent is the generic 溶剂 in claim 1; claim 4 names 四氯化碳，氯仿，二氯甲烷或 1,2-二氯乙烷, all four listed in compounds[] with role solvent although only one would be used. Claim 4 also prints the substrate with the substituents in a different order, 2-氯-4-甲磺酰基-3-甲基苯甲酸甲酯, which A1 keeps as an alias of the same compound. No charge and no yield are stated.

notes: Chinese heading: 6)2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的合成. ONE-POT WITH A CAVEAT: claim 1 recites two transformations under a single numbered step, an etherification then a hydrolysis, and is_one_pot is set true on that basis with both transformations listed in one_pot_steps in document order; reaction_class follows the final transformation (hydrolysis) as the rule requires, while named_reaction records the Williamson ether synthesis of the first. Strictly the two are not a single pot: 然后水洗，浓缩 interposes a water wash and a concentration, and the residue is then redissolved (将残余物溶于溶剂中) before the hydroxide is added. The intermediate is nonetheless never isolated or purified, and the claim gives the pair one step number and one final product, so they are kept as one record rather than split; the interposed operations are recorded in workup.steps and marked as interstage. NAMING INCONSISTENCY, recorded as printed and not corrected: the substrate is the methyl ester 2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯 and the only other reagent is 2,2,2-三氟乙醇钠, yet the first-stage product is named 苯甲酸乙酯, the ethyl ester, and no ethyl source appears anywhere in the step. The A1 identifier is kept as printed. translation_conflict is NOT raised for it because that flag covers the Chinese and the English naming different compounds, and here they agree: the Chinese prints 乙酯 and the EN line prints ethyl, so the inconsistency is internal to the document rather than a translation divergence, and no listed flag covers it. Conditions cover two stages: 在室温下搅拌 (stirred at room temperature) for the etherification, held in conditions.temperature, and 回流反应 (refluxed) for the hydrolysis, held in heating_method; which stage each belongs to is recorded here because only one conditions object exists. Time: the hydrolysis states 1-4h, a range that time_h cannot hold, so time_h is null and the range is recorded here as printed; the etherification is given no time. The solvent is the generic 溶剂 in claim 1 for both stages; claim 5 names 四氢呋喃，乙腈，二氯甲烷或甲苯 for this step, all four listed in compounds[] with role solvent although only one would be used. Because those four span aprotic polar, halogenated and hydrocarbon classes, no solvent_class tag is emitted rather than guessing one. 干燥 names no drying agent, so workup.drying_agent is null. Acidification states no pH number, so ph_target is null. No charge and no yield are stated.

procedure_text: 在反应瓶中加入2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸、N，N-二甲基甲酰胺和溶剂，在室温下，滴加氯化亚砜，升温回流搅拌，蒸除溶剂，残余物加入二氯甲烷， 冷却后，加入环己二酮和碱的混合物，室温搅拌，反应物水洗，干燥，浓缩得油状物2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸3-氧代-1-环己烯酯；
procedure_summary: The benzoic acid from the preceding step is converted to its acid chloride with thionyl chloride and N,N-dimethylformamide at reflux, the solvent is distilled off and the residue taken up in dichloromethane. Cyclohexanedione and base are then added as a mixture at room temperature, acylating the dione on oxygen; the mixture is washed with water, dried and concentrated to the enol ester as an oil.
notes: Chinese heading: 7)2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸3-氧代-1-环己烯酯的合成. ONE-POT: two transformations run under one step number with no aqueous workup between them, only a solvent swap (蒸除溶剂，残余物加入二氯甲烷), so is_one_pot is true and both transformations are listed in one_pot_steps in document order. reaction_class follows the final transformation, the O-acylation of the dione, which forms the enol ester, hence ester_formation; acylation is also carried as a transformation tag. No canonical named reaction is recorded because none plainly applies to either stage. NAMING INCONSISTENCY, recorded as printed and not corrected: the dione is printed 环己二酮 with no ring locants in both claim 1 and claim 6, so nothing in this section fixes which cyclohexanedione isomer is meant; the A1 record is unresolved for the same reason and the identifier is kept as printed. The product name, 3-氧代-1-环己烯酯, implies the 1,3-isomer but the claim never says so, and that inference is not written into the compound record. Conditions cover two stages: 在室温下，滴加氯化亚砜 and the later 室温搅拌 are both at room temperature, held in conditions.temperature, while 升温回流搅拌 between them is held in heating_method; which stage each belongs to is recorded here. 冷却后 (after cooling) names no cooling method, so cooling_method stays null. No reaction time is given for either stage. The first-stage solvent is the generic 溶剂 and no dependent claim names it for this step; only the second-stage 二氯甲烷 is named outright. N,N-dimethylformamide is given no role word and is left out of the claim 6 molar ratio, so its role is kept at additive as in A1 rather than called a catalyst. The base is the generic 碱 in claim 1 and 无机碱或有机碱 in claim 6; claims 7 and 8 name 碳酸钠，碳酸钾，氢氧化钠或氢氧化钾 and 吡啶或三乙胺 respectively, and all six are listed in compounds[] with role base although only one would be used; no catalyst_class tag is emitted because the claim does not present the base as a catalyst. workup.concentration_method records 蒸除溶剂 as distillation; the final 浓缩 that gives the oil states no method. No charge and no yield are stated.

procedure_text: 在装有干燥管的反应瓶中加入2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸3-氧代-1-环己烯酯、氰基丙酮和三乙胺溶于溶剂中在室温持续搅拌，蒸除溶剂，萃取，水洗，干燥，浓缩得米黄色固体环磺草酮。
procedure_summary: The enol ester from the preceding step is stirred at room temperature in solvent with cyanoacetone and triethylamine in a flask fitted with a drying tube, the aroyl group migrating from oxygen to the ring carbon of the dione. The solvent is distilled off and the mixture extracted, washed with water, dried and concentrated to the herbicide as a beige solid.
notes: Chinese heading: 8)环磺草酮的合成, the final step, whose product is the section product. CLASSIFICATION: the transformation is the migration of the aroyl group from the enol oxygen to the ring carbon of the dione, converting the enol ester into the 2-aroylcyclohexane-1,3-dione, a Fries-type rearrangement promoted by a cyanide source with an amine base. The closed reaction_class list has no rearrangement entry, so reaction_class is other with the reasoning recorded here and transformation:rearrangement carried as a tag; acylation was considered and not used as the class because no external acyl donor is charged, the acyl group already being present in the substrate. named_reaction is null because no widely accepted name fits without stretching: this is not a classical Fries rearrangement, which is a Lewis-acid promoted aryl ester rearrangement. Conditions: 装有干燥管 (fitted with a drying tube) means moisture exclusion, so atmosphere is dry; nitrogen is not named anywhere and is not inferred. 在室温持续搅拌 gives room temperature and continuous stirring, but the text does not say what kind of stirrer, so conditions.stirring.type is left null. No time is stated. The solvent is the generic 溶剂 and no dependent claim names a solvent for this step, so no solvent_class tag is emitted and no solvent compound is listed. Roles: the claim gives cyanoacetone and triethylamine no role word; A1 records cyanoacetone as a reagent rather than a reactant because the whole carbon skeleton of the product is already present in the step 7 enol ester, and that is kept here. 得米黄色固体 gives the product as a beige solid, recorded on the A1 compound record. No charge, no yield and no analytical data are stated.
